calls.reasoning: Window Nov 9-20 (P0 = Nov 6 close) contains NVDA Q3 FY27 earnings Nov 17 after close, reaction Nov 18. Options imply ~±8-8.8% NVDA move through Nov 20; historical median day-after move 4.9% (3.3% for November reports). AAPL earnings already past, so its 2-week vol is ~4%. Spread SD ~7.5pp; median near zero with a slight positive tilt for NVDA's higher beta. Fat tails mean about 3% each side beyond ±15. No matching human market was found.
